### Confessing Jesus with Your Mouth
Author: Steffen Mueller
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/confessing-jesus-with-your-mouth
Passage: Matthew 10:32
Points:
- Living an obedient Christian life is essential, but it cannot replace verbally sharing Jesus.
- Genuine salvation involves believing with the heart and openly confessing the Lord with the mouth.
- Vague discussions about spirituality fall short if believers avoid specifically naming Christ.
- Speaking the name of Jesus confronts listeners with who He is and the only way of salvation.

### What to Say and How to Say It (Luke 12:11-12) - Your Daily Bible Verse - May 13
Author: Jennifer Waddle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-may-13.html
Passage: Luke 12:11-12
Points:
- Followers of Jesus are commissioned to acknowledge Him boldly before others without fear.
- Believers often worry about how to defend their faith when facing criticism in an adversarial culture.
- Rehearsing arguments or trying to win disputes in the flesh only promotes conflict and bitterness.
- Christians can rely on the Holy Spirit to supply the right words, wisdom, and timing.
- Prayerful dependence on God enables believers to speak the truth in love and patience.
